tasks.description:
Define and document the core project team structure as specified in the requirements. The team should consist of 4-5 people with clearly defined roles: Product Manager (1), Technical Lead (1), Backend/CLI Developer (2), and Quality Assurance (1).

This task involves creating the organizational structure, defining reporting lines, and establishing communication channels between team members. The structure must support the development of a CLI tool with Notion API integration.

The team structure serves as the foundation for all subsequent development activities and ensures proper resource allocation and accountability across the project lifecycle.

parameters.project_type: CLI tool with Notion API integration

tasks.task_notes: This is a foundational task that must be completed before role-specific tasks can be assigned. Ensure clear delineation of responsibilities to avoid overlap. Consider team members' skills and experience when assigning specific roles.

requirement_snippets:
Project Team (4-5 people)
├── Product Manager (1)
├── Technical Lead (1)
├── Backend/CLI Developer (2)
└── Quality Assurance (1)
success_criteria: Team structure document created with all 4-5 roles defined
Each role has exactly the specified number of people assigned
Organizational chart reflects the hierarchical structure shown in requirements

tasks.task_name: Define and assign Product Manager responsibilities
tasks.description:
Establish the Product Manager role with comprehensive responsibilities as specified in the requirements. The Product Manager is responsible for defining and prioritizing the feature roadmap, gathering user requirements and feedback, coordinating between stakeholders and the development team, managing project timeline and milestones, ensuring business requirements are met, and creating user documentation and marketing materials.

This role is critical for aligning business objectives with technical implementation and ensuring the CLI tool meets user needs and market requirements.

The Product Manager serves as the primary interface between stakeholders and the development team, making this a pivotal role for project success.

responsibilities: Coordinate between stakeholders and development team

tasks.task_notes: The Product Manager role requires strong communication skills and business acumen. Ensure the selected individual has experience with CLI tools and developer-focused products. This role will drive the overall project direction and prioritization.

requirement_snippets:
Product Manager (1)
**Responsibilities:**
- Define and prioritize feature roadmap
- Gather user requirements and feedback
- Coordinate between stakeholders and development team
- Manage project timeline and milestones
- Ensure business requirements are met
- User documentation and marketing materials
success_criteria: Product Manager role definition document created
All six core responsibilities documented and assigned
Clear escalation paths and stakeholder communication protocols established

tasks.task_name: Create Product Manager MVP deliverables framework
tasks.description:
Establish the framework and templates for Product Manager MVP deliverables as specified in the requirements. The Product Manager must deliver four key artifacts for the MVP: user stories and acceptance criteria, MVP scope definition, user testing plan, and go-to-market strategy for the CLI tool.

These deliverables are critical success criteria for the MVP phase and must be completed to ensure the product meets user needs and business objectives. Each deliverable should have clear templates, guidelines, and review processes.

This task focuses on creating the infrastructure and processes that enable the Product Manager to produce high-quality deliverables consistently.
tasks.task_notes: These deliverables form the foundation for development work. Templates should be created early to allow the Product Manager to begin populating them. Consider industry best practices for CLI tool development and developer-focused products.

requirement_snippets:
**MVP Deliverables:**
- User stories and acceptance criteria
- MVP scope definition
- User testing plan
- Go-to-market strategy for CLI tool
success_criteria: User stories and acceptance criteria template created and populated
MVP scope definition document completed with clear boundaries
User testing plan documented with test scenarios and success metrics
Go-to-market strategy for CLI tool drafted with distribution and adoption plans
dependencies: Define and assign Product Manager responsibilities

tasks.task_name: Define and assign Technical Lead responsibilities
tasks.description:
Establish the Technical Lead role with comprehensive responsibilities as specified in the requirements. The Technical Lead is responsible for architecture design and technical decisions, code review and quality standards, implementation of core modules, integration with Notion API, performance and security oversight, and mentoring other developers.

This role is critical for ensuring technical excellence, maintaining code quality, and guiding the development team through complex technical challenges. The Technical Lead must balance hands-on development with architectural oversight and team mentorship.

The Technical Lead serves as the primary technical authority on the project and is responsible for all major technical decisions affecting the CLI tool's architecture and implementation.
tasks.task_notes: The Technical Lead must have deep expertise in CLI development, API integration (specifically Notion API), and strong mentorship capabilities. This person will drive technical standards and best practices across the codebase. Consider requiring experience with Python or Node.js for CLI development.

requirement_snippets:
Technical Lead (1)
**Responsibilities:**
- Architecture design and technical decisions
- Code review and quality standards
- Implementation of core modules
- Integration with Notion API
- Performance and security oversight
- Mentoring other developers
success_criteria: Technical Lead role definition document created
All six core responsibilities documented and assigned
Technical decision-making framework established
Code review processes and quality standards documented
Mentorship plan created for backend/CLI developers

tasks.task_name: Define Backend/CLI Developer roles and responsibilities
tasks.description:
Establish roles and responsibilities for the two Backend/CLI Developer positions as specified in the team structure requirements. These developers will work under the Technical Lead's guidance to implement the CLI tool and backend services, including Notion API integration.

While the requirement specification does not provide detailed role definitions for Backend/CLI Developers, this task involves defining their responsibilities based on the context that they will be implementing CLI functionality, integrating with Notion API, and working on core modules under the Technical Lead's direction.

The two developers should have complementary skills and clearly divided areas of focus to maximize efficiency and minimize conflicts.
tasks.task_notes: The detailed responsibilities for Backend/CLI Developers are not explicitly provided in the requirement chunks, but they are clearly part of the team structure. Consider splitting responsibilities between the two developers (e.g., one focused on CLI interface, one on backend/API integration). Ensure alignment with Technical Lead's architecture decisions.

requirement_snippets:
Project Team (4-5 people)
├── Product Manager (1)
├── Technical Lead (1)
├── Backend/CLI Developer (2)
└── Quality Assurance (1)
success_criteria: Backend/CLI Developer role definition document created for both positions
Clear division of responsibilities between the two developers established
Reporting structure to Technical Lead documented
Development workflows and collaboration protocols defined
dependencies: Define and assign Technical Lead responsibilities

tasks.task_name: Define Quality Assurance role and responsibilities
tasks.description:
Establish the Quality Assurance role and responsibilities as specified in the team structure requirements. The QA engineer will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and correctness of the CLI tool and its integration with the Notion API.

While the requirement specification does not provide detailed role definitions for the QA position, this task involves defining responsibilities based on the context of testing a CLI tool with API integration, including functional testing, integration testing, user acceptance testing coordination, and quality metrics.

The QA role is critical for ensuring the MVP meets the acceptance criteria and user testing plan defined by the Product Manager.
tasks.task_notes: The detailed responsibilities for QA are not explicitly provided in the requirement chunks, but the role is clearly part of the team structure. The QA engineer should work closely with the Product Manager on user testing plans and with the Technical Lead on test automation strategies. Consider requiring experience with CLI testing frameworks and API testing tools.

success_criteria: Quality Assurance role definition document created
Testing strategy and responsibilities documented
Quality metrics and success criteria defined
Bug tracking and reporting processes established
Coordination protocols with Product Manager and Technical Lead defined
dependencies: Create Product Manager MVP deliverables framework

tasks.task_name: Establish team coordination and communication protocols
tasks.description:
Create comprehensive team coordination and communication protocols to ensure effective collaboration across the 4-5 person team. This task addresses the Product Manager's responsibility to 'coordinate between stakeholders and development team' and ensures all team members can work effectively together.

Protocols should include regular meeting schedules, communication channels, decision-making processes, escalation paths, and documentation standards. Special attention should be given to coordination between the Product Manager (business side) and Technical Lead (technical side) to ensure alignment.

Effective coordination protocols are essential for a small team working on a CLI tool with external API dependencies, as they minimize miscommunication and ensure rapid issue resolution.
tasks.task_notes: This task supports the Product Manager's coordination responsibilities and ensures the team can operate efficiently. Consider implementing agile ceremonies (standups, retrospectives) appropriate for a small team. Ensure protocols are lightweight enough to not create overhead but structured enough to maintain alignment.

requirement_snippets: Product Manager responsibilities: Coordinate between stakeholders and development team
Technical Lead responsibilities: Mentoring other developers
Project Team (4-5 people) with defined roles
success_criteria: Team communication protocols documented and shared
Regular meeting schedule established and accepted by all team members
Decision-making framework defined with clear authority at each level
Escalation paths documented for technical and business issues
Documentation standards and collaboration tools selected and configured
dependencies: Define and assign Product Manager responsibilities
Define and assign Technical Lead responsibilities
